A [[Rodian]] was a '''customer''' of [[Peli Motto]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Chapter 18" /> around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|18}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian appeared in "[[Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore]]," the eighteenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Rachel Morrison]]. [[Dawn Dininger]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 18" />

According to a post by [[David W. Collins]] on Twitter, he voiced the Rodian.<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|username=DavidWCollins|url=status/1635309086081437696|name=David W. Collins|date=2023-03-13|quote=Rumor has it that I voiced this Rodian chatting with #PeliMotto in Chapter 18 of #TheMandalorian. This rumor is true. #voiceover|archivedate=20230313232856}}</ref>
